name: ImageDrawOval
syntax: ImageDrawOval( any image, number x, number y, number width, number height, [boolean filled] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the upper left corner of the oval to draw.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the upper left corner of the oval to draw.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the oval to draw.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the oval to draw.

params.name: filled
params.description:
Specify whether the oval is filled:

- true: The oval is filled with the specified drawing color.
- false (default): Only the outline of the oval is drawn.
